verdict: Off is a good place to start. On 18 long RealKIE invoices (8 to 33 pages), agentic extraction with table parsing scored no better (line-item score 52% on, 56% off, within the noise) and cost more (at least $257 against $210 per 1,000 invoices; agentic calls over 100,000 tokens, which Claude Haiku 5.5 bills at a higher rate, can't be priced from our metering) and took longer. Test it on your own long tables.
